<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="0.8" border="0"> <diagram name="Página-1" id="ziMUf1TweQeDnvHBV0zs"> <mxGraphModel dx="1707" dy="938" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1100" pageHeight="850" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "classDiagram
 %% Pacote Core (O Jogo Concreto)
 class Game {
 -Board board
 -List~Player~ players
 -Turn turnManager
 -WinCondition winCondition
 -boolean isGameOver
 -Player winner
 +Game()
 +start() void
 +play(move: Move) void
 +isGameOver() boolean
 +getWinner() Player
 -validateMove(move: Move) boolean
 -checkEndGame(lastMove: Move) void
 }

 class Board {
 -int rows
 -int columns
 -Piece[][] grid
 +Board(rows: int, columns: int)
 +getRows() int
 +getColumns() int
 +getPiece(position: Position) Piece
 +placePiece(piece: Piece, position: Position) void
 +isValidPosition(position: Position) boolean
 +isOccupied(position: Position) boolean
 +print() void
 }

 class Position {
 -int row
 -int column
 +Position(row: int, column: int)
 +getRow() int
 +getColumn() int
 +equals(obj: Object) boolean
 }

 class Player {
 -int id
 -String symbol
 +Player(id: int, symbol: String)
 +getId() int
 +getSymbol() String
 }

 class Piece {
 -Player owner
 -String symbol
 +Piece(owner: Player, symbol: String)
 +getOwner() Player
 +getSymbol() String
 }

 class Turn {
 -List~Player~ players
 -int currentPlayerIndex
 +Turn(players: List~Player~)
 +getCurrentPlayer() Player
 +nextTurn() void
 }

 class Move {
 -Player player
 -Position target
 +Move(player: Player, target: Position)
 +getPlayer() Player
 +getTarget() Position
 }

 %% Condições de Vitória (Início da generalização)
 class WinCondition {
 <<interface>>
 +checkWin(board: Board, lastMove: Move) boolean
 }

 class AlignmentWinCondition {
 +checkWin(board: Board, lastMove: Move) boolean
 -checkRow(board: Board, move: Move) boolean
 -checkColumn(board: Board, move: Move) boolean
 -checkDiagonal(board: Board, move: Move) boolean
 }
 
 %% Exceções Básicas
 class InvalidMoveException {
 <<Exception>>
 }

 %% Relacionamentos
 Game *-- Board : <<composição>>
 Game *-- Turn : <<composição>>
 Game o-- Player : <<agregação>>
 Game --> WinCondition : usa
 Game --> Player : winner
 
 Board *-- Position : usa
 Board --> Piece : contém
 
 Piece --> Player : pertence a
 Turn --> Player : gerencia
 Move --> Player : feito por
 Move --> Position : destino
 
 WinCondition <|.. AlignmentWinCondition : <<implements>>",
 "config": null
